# BUSINESS AND MARKETS [italic]The numbers behind better worlds. All prices Gateway close, delayed for the colonies.[/italic]
## THE BOARD - [bold]Weyland-Yutani[/bold]: up, as usual. Strong colony returns, strong synthetic sales, strong outlook. - [bold]Hyperdyne Systems[/bold]: flat. Hyperdyne continues to make good synthetics, for a smaller company. - [bold]Seegson[/bold]: down again. The Working Joe remains a dependable product for customers who value dependability over everything else, including conversation. - [bold]Lasalle Bionational[/bold]: up, on news of the renewed frontier clinic agreement. - [bold]Koorlander[/bold]: steady. Colonists continue to smoke.
## COMPANY PRODUCTS IN THE NEWS
- [bold]Shio Royals[/bold], the Company's own cigar, rolled in Japan, now stocked on the frontier. Our reviewer called them dependable. Rival cigar houses called them OK. We call that a consensus. - [bold]We-Ya Gold[/bold] cigarettes, the Company's premium smoke, are now available in a four pack in selected rations. - [bold]Hypersleep pods[/bold] from the Company's own yards now carry a two year warranty. Pods with a warranty, the Company points out, are pods you wake up from.
## COMPETITORS The Union of Progressive Peoples has announced a new five year plan for its colonies. Prosperity Today has read it. It is a plan, it lasts five years and it involves a great deal of digging. We wish them well.
## TIPS FOR THE COLONIAL INVESTOR - Your contract is your best investment. Keep it current. - The company store accepts all major colony scrip. - Do not invest in anything advertised on the relay by someone who says they are a celebrity. They are not.
